regions.cleaned_text: you and yours, especially our young brothers the Novices, with whom you are now seemingly in a sort of exile from your former nest in St. Bonaventure. And of course to Fr. Alouise, for the past years (3 or 4) my next neighbor at Saint Felix's. I can hardly help missing him more than I usually do in most cases because I knew him ... as a novice and now again after close to 25 years - possibly more. However, that is the way it goes in the Order as well as in secular life; though in the latter it is very much more disapoint- ing. Anyhow, best wishes to Fr. Aloisius and to all the novices and God's blessing to all in St. Francis, your new Novitiate. It is possible that before the summer is over I may have the privilege there for a day or so, God willing so, I'll be pleased. Till then In the mean time we'll do well to continue praying mutually for further conversion and - hearkening to our dear Lord's Own most earnest plea . "Pray we the Lord of the Harvest that He send laborers into His harvest".
